visualCharacteristics: A signup form: text/email/ZIP fields, a checkbox group, consent/legal copy, and a submit button.
contentPattern: One row per field, each self-describing: first cell is the field type (text | email | zip | checkbox-group | legal | submit), remaining cells provide label, name, and options. Controls are built in JS because DA strips form markup from the fragment.

application.visualCharacteristics: Complex validated application form in a navy card: grouped Name / Address fieldsets with sub-labels under the inputs, two-column rows from 1024px, date and file-upload fields, a required acknowledgement checkbox, inline pink 'Required field' pills, reCAPTCHA v3 and a small centred Submit.
